value.rationale: The exact 5:1 mixing-to-pure-parity transition is a new structural boundary for sharp sixth-power central Fourier synthesis: support patterns with four versus five majority-parity modes per minority mode behave differently at leading order. Universality by parity counts and complete phase rigidity give reusable sharp high-weight constraints; noncentral and growing-bandwidth questions remain outside the claim.
